title: Department of Botany, AWKUM to Organize One-Day Seminar in Collaboration with PlantPulse, iBuilders, and Haryali Club
text:
The Department of Botany, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan, in collaboration with PlantPulse, iBuilders, and Haryali Club, is organizing a one-day seminar focusing on pressing environmental challenges and the role of botany in addressing climate change.

The seminar, titled

“When the Skies Break: Understanding Cloudbursts, Floods and the Role of Botany in a Warming Climate,”

is scheduled to be held on

Thursday, May 7, 2026, at 10:30 AM

.
The event will take place at the

Main Hall, Department of Sports, Block No. 09
.

Dr. Khalid Khan (KKK)
, a renowned Synoptic Systems Architect and a leading voice in climate action and sustainable development, will deliver the keynote talk. He serves as Captain of PlanetPulse and is also the Founder of Haryali Club and iBuilders—initiatives dedicated to building resilient ecosystems, institutions, and communities.

The Honourable Vice Chancellor will attend the seminar to grace the academic session.

All faculty members, students, and relevant stakeholders are encouraged to participate in the event. Chairpersons of various departments are especially requested to ensure the attendance of students as per the given schedule.
